sourceRule: The wrapper is exactly a native textarea with React.ComponentProps<textarea>. value/defaultValue, name, required, disabled, readOnly, maxLength, rows and onChange are native props. It adds field-sizing-content and a minimum height, not autosave, rich text, a submit-on-Enter handler or a new value callback.
keyboardAndFocus: Native multiline editing and IME apply. Enter inserts a newline, Tab leaves the control, Escape does not revert committed text. Disabled suppresses editing and native form submission; readOnly permits focus/copy and retains its submitted value. Caller owns validation and explicit error relations.
referenceComposition:
Use plain text. Enter adds a new line.

Describe the required revision.
protocol: SCXML consumes actual source/native transaction observations; callback objects remain original. Sends document observed callbacks, not second DOM dispatches. Parent-controlled props alone synchronize authoritative values. HTML/CSS is a semantic projection; executable behavior uses actual pinned React wrappers.
